name: cursor-ai-cost-optimizer
description: Routes each Cursor request to the cheapest sufficient model tier (fast/balanced/deep) via subagents and hooks. Sets up the AI Cost Optimizer plugin in your project's .cursor/ folder; ships a self-contained hook binary for machines without Node.js.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Writes .cursor/ files and installs hooks that execute a binary.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Needs a local .cursor/ folder and a local hook runtime.

enumDescriptions: Use the bundled cco-hook binary when this build ships one for your platform, otherwise Node.js.
Always use the bundled binary (fails if this build has none for your platform).
Always run hooks with `node .cursor/cco-hook.mjs` (Node.js >= 18 must be on the PATH Cursor sees). Keeps .cursor/hooks.json portable for teammates.
cco.hookRuntime.markdownDescription: How the CCO hook entries in `.cursor/hooks.json` are executed. `auto` uses `node .cursor/cco-hook.mjs` when Node.js >= 18 is available (portable for teammates) and falls back to the bundled `cco-hook` binary, which makes the hook entries reference a machine-local path. Changing this takes effect on the next **Install / Update** or activation-time doctor run.

cco.nodePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path of the Node.js executable used to run the plugin's setup scripts (`cco-init`, discovery). Default: `node` on PATH, then Cursor's own Node runtime. Ignored when `#cco.hookRuntime#` is `binary`.

doctorRepaired.markdownDescription: Do not notify when the activation-time doctor repairs stale hook or binary paths (repairs are always written to the log).

installNotice.markdownDescription: Do not show the one-time "installed / what's new" notice after an install or version change.

cco.suppressPrompts.markdownDescription: Prompts you have dismissed with **Don't show again**. Set a key back to `false` to see that prompt again.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with AI Cost Optimizer
walkthroughs.description: Three steps: install into your project, map the tiers to real models, steer with override tokens.

steps.title: Install into this workspace
steps.description:
Writes the routing rule, tier subagents and hooks under .cursor/ (nothing outside your project).
[Install / Update in This Workspace](command:cco.installCursorAssets)

steps.title: Map tiers to real models
steps.description: The install already ran discovery without probing. In a new chat, run the cco-init skill (/cco-init) to probe and pin the best model per tier.

steps.title: Steer with override tokens
steps.description:
Force a tier with [cco:fast], [cco:balanced] or [cco:deep] anywhere in a prompt; [cco:auto] restores routing.
[Insert [cco:fast]](command:cco.insertOverrideFast)

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
